{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor disks''' were small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] devices big enough to strap on a [[Human/Legends|Human]] foot. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze Loneozner]] used two repulsor disks strapped to his feet when he invented the sport of [[sandsurfing]].
